story.title: U.S. Announces Oil Deal with Venezuela Amid Skepticism on Gas Prices
story.summary: The U.S. government has announced a new oil agreement with Venezuela, granting the U.S. majority control over 65 billion barrels of proven oil reserves. The deal, brokered through a partnership with private business, was revealed by President Trump and involves Venezuela's interim president, Delcy Rodríguez. However, energy experts express skepticism regarding the potential impact of this deal on gas prices in the U.S.

related_stories.title: Jury Deliberates in Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial
related_stories.summary: Jurors are currently deliberating in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is charged with the murder of her three children. They have five options to consider: guilty of murder, guilty of manslaughter, or acquittal based on a lack of control due to psychiatric issues. This marks the third day of deliberations.

related_stories.title: Ebola Outbreak in DRC Exceeds 6,000 Cases with Nearly 3,000 Deaths
related_stories.summary: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 6,000 confirmed cases, with the death toll reaching 2,911. This outbreak is noted as the largest in the country's history and one of the fastest-growing Ebola epidemics ever recorded. Over 1,360 individuals have reportedly recovered from the virus.

related_stories.title: Severe Flooding in Nepal and Tibet Leaves Nearly 1,000 Dead and Thousands Missing
related_stories.summary: Severe flooding along the Nepal-China border has resulted in nearly 1,000 confirmed deaths, with over 4,000 individuals reported missing. The disaster has caused significant despair among families affected by the floods. Relief efforts are being severely hampered by heavy rain, which has turned roads into mud, complicating rescue operations.
